content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be expected to be treated as such.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATION_OF_CONFIDENTIALITY
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of ten (10) years from the date of execution.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of April 2024.
